topology_reasoning.what_it_is: A grating-assisted contra-directional coupler (Bragg-type add/drop filter) drawn in a folded, mirror-symmetric layout. Five horizontal tracks: a continuous central bus strip, flanked above and below at a small gap by two identical periodically-segmented (subwavelength/comb) waveguide sections of 56 teeth each, with the teeth of both combs at identical x positions. Each comb section is the middle of a folded strip waveguide: the top path enters as a needle (inverse) taper at the upper left, runs along the top edge, folds through a 180-degree U-bend on the right, and returns as the upper comb; a thin, width-tapering S-lead exits it at the top-left corner. The bottom path is the 180-degree rotational twin: needle taper pointing right at the bottom, straight along the bottom, U-bend on the left, lower comb, thin S-lead exiting at the bottom-right corner. The central bus is isolated: flat square ends, no connection to either folded path.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: The continuous central strip is the bus. Each comb row is a segmented waveguide whose periodic index modulation (pitch ~156 nm in the calibrated frame, 56 periods) phase-matches contra-directional coupling between the bus mode and the grating-arm mode at lambda ~ (n_bus + n_arm) * pitch. Light injected via a tapered S-lead travels along a comb arm; within the coupling length set by the grating span and the bus overlap, the resonant band is transferred to the bus (backward), while out-of-band light continues around the fold. The needle tapers at the strip ends are non-reflective terminations (they radiate the residual power adiabatically instead of reflecting it), which is why the two strip guides end in points rather than ports. Function is set by: grating pitch (center wavelength), duty cycle and tooth width (grating strength / effective index), bus-to-comb gap (coupling kappa), number of periods and bus length (interaction length, bandwidth, extinction), and the guide widths (mode indices).
topology_reasoning.confidence: Topology and connectivity: high (pixel-measured). Functional family (contra-DC / SWG-assisted coupler): plausible inference from geometry; does not change the recreation.
topology_reasoning.anomaly_note: footprint.json gives 18.24 x 0.7 um while the image is 3712 x 1152 px, so the gate calibration is strongly anisotropic (sx=200.05 px/um, sy=1620 px/um, ratio 8.1). Taken literally the cross-sections are tens of nm, i.e. the figure is a vertically-stretched schematic; the gate is IoU at this calibration, so the script is built in the calibrated frame as-is. Consequence: image-circular U-bends are ellipses in physical um (Rx ~ 8x Ry), and stroke width perpendicular to a path differs between horizontal runs and bend apexes, so U-bends are built as ellipse-annulus booleans rather than extruded arcs.
topology_reasoning.registration_note: The gate left-aligns the GDS bbox to the target bbox and vertically centers it. Target bbox [63,18,3712,1152] is pinned top-right by a 1-px ink speck at (y=20, x=3711) and bottom-right by the S-lead tail running off the image corner. The script reproduces the speck as a tiny sliver and starts the top-left S-lead tip exactly at the bbox left edge so that both alignments land exactly.

iterations.change_made: Initial build: anisotropic calibrated frame (sx=200.05, sy=1620 px/um); tracks/teeth/bar as rectangles, needle tapers, ellipse-annulus boolean U-bends, slope-corrected Path+extrude chains for tapering S-leads, uniform-pitch teeth, registration sliver.

Diff showed tooth-phase jitter dominates: embedded measured per-tooth position/width table (target pitch wanders +/-9 px, identical in both combs). Recalibrated track widths to the 245-threshold target, split top/bottom wg widths (110.7 vs 107.5 px), corrected bar extent, thinned faded S2 tail, fixed x<0 end-cap and sliver overhangs (left-align + centering registration).

Killed a 1 nm sliver overhang above y=0.7 that shifted the whole render 0.8 px down (odd-nm rect heights inflate 1 nm); chose knob values so track lower edges land on integer nm; widened teeth 0.75 px/side; bar/bend/tail/S1-tip trims.

Regression experiment: thr-200 tooth table + wider bar + larger bend outer radii overshot (FP nearly doubled). Kept discoveries: landing starts px 2703 (was ~1 px late), upper-right landing tilts ~7 px up into the bend junction (tilted chain + annulus comb-side lift), asymmetric bus gaps.
Rolled back the iter-4 losers (128-table teeth, bar 0.0266 at half-coverage rows, moderate bend radii), kept landing-start fix + UR-landing tilt + bend lift + tail/bar-x/taper-tip trims.

Per-tooth least-error fit of each tooth box (shift in 0.25 px steps, width in 0.5 px steps) against the gate-threshold target column profile, baked into the table; measured trailing gap 7.7 px. Final.
